title: Core normalized comparison data
statement: For an isomorphism of schemes and the recorded closed structures and tensor models, there exists a normalized Comparison containing the chain, derived, tensor, and all representative normalization fields.

proof.text: Combine the product-Hom and derived resolution-model comparisons with the sectionwise tensor comparison. Totalize pure tensors, descend through localization on independent K-flat representatives, and use the K-injective model equations to populate every field of Comparison.

mathlib_searches.results: Existing declarations provide Hom and resolution data but no assembled Comparison constructor.
mathlib_searches.verdict: The core assembly remains an intermediate theorem.

lean.statement: theorem comparison_core_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ) (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s) (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY) : Nonempty (Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY)
